Vilmorin-Andrieux et Cie (Paris) trade catalogues -- REMAINDER of the series.
The main corpus already holds 1863, 1865, 1869, 1874, 1880-81, 1884, 1890 and 1900.
These complete the run so that each tomato variety's first and last appearance
in the Vilmorin trade can be dated to the year.
Retrieved 2026-08-30 from the Internet Archive. All public domain.
PDFs are IMAGE-ONLY: term-search the accompanying *.ocr.txt, not the PDF.
